office: the police inspectorate of the municipality, district or khan (General Department of Identification)

routes.label: at the municipal, district or khan police inspectorate: 30 working days

note: Open Development Cambodia's table of public services, from the Inter-ministerial Prakas No. 14414 (30 December 2016) and the General Department of Identification's leaflet: the Cambodian identification card is free, issued in 30 working days, valid ten years (as Sub-decree 36 of 1996 sets, article 2). The age from which it's issued is garbled in the English text of the sub-decree read, so the card is offered at any age.
